charts.name: shelter_pressure
charts.title: How close are shelters to reported capacity?
charts.explanation: Compare the occupancy lines with the dashed threshold. Each ratio is weighted by its own reported actual capacity. The threshold is illustrative.

charts.name: shelter_backtest
charts.title: Did our 7-day predictions match what happened?
charts.explanation: The orange prediction should follow the blue actual series. The dashed line is the persistence baseline. This example does not represent every sector or horizon.

charts.name: backlog_projection
charts.title: How has the housing waiting list changed?
charts.explanation: Blue shows published history. Orange dots are forecasts and vertical bars show empirical uncertainty, without guaranteed coverage. The gray dashed line is persistence.

charts.name: backlog_model_errors
charts.title: Did the backlog model beat a simple baseline?
charts.explanation: Compare bars within each horizon. The orange model has larger errors than persistence. Keep the baseline visible when presenting model performance.
